groups.title: Stamped and Decorative Concrete
groups.summary: Custom stamped textures and colored finishes that stand up to Texas heat.
groups.intro: Stamped concrete is decorative concrete that is textured, patterned and colored to duplicate the look of natural slate, flagstone, brick, cobblestone or wood plank. While the freshly poured concrete is still plastic, specialized rigid polyurethane stamps are pressed into the surface after color hardeners and release agents are applied.
groups.imageAlt: A stamped concrete patio under a timber pergola behind a brick house

about.title: Craftsmanship led personally by Marco Castanon
text: Castanon Concrete Designs was founded on a simple principle: homeowners deserve direct access to the craftsman responsible for their property. Marco Castanon, Owner and CEO, personally supervises every project from initial site grading and reinforcement tie-offs to the final wash and seal.

With over a decade of hands-on experience in the Greater Houston trade, Marco brings structural rigor and architectural design insight to every pour. We don't cut corners on concrete strength or reinforcement spacing, which is why 98% of our clients recommend our work to their neighbors.

facts.heading: Estimates and pricing
facts.text: Pricing is quote-based rather than a flat rate: ground conditions, square footage, reinforcement and the finish you choose all shape the scope. On-site estimates are free and carry no obligation. Call or email Marco directly, or request one online. Decorative finishes are offered at contractor-direct pricing.

facts.heading: What the free estimate visit covers
facts.text: Marco Castanon comes to the property himself to take laser measurements, inspect how the ground drains and go through stamp samples with you, then writes up an accurate scope of work and a transparent itemized quote.

facts.heading: What shapes the price
items: Total square footage, and the thickness the slab needs
Demolition of old slabs, excavation and subgrade preparation
Site access for concrete mixer trucks or wheelbarrows
Reinforcement schedule, rebar or fiber mesh
How much decorative color and stamping you choose

facts.heading: How a project runs
items: On-site consultation and estimate, then detailed layout and permitting where it is required
Site clearing, laser leveling and subbase compaction
Framing with wood or steel forms, with rebar placed on chairs
Pour and finish, control joint cutting, then proper curing
On stamped work: color hardener and release agent, pattern stamping, relief joints, power washing and two protective seal coats

facts.heading: Timeline and curing
items: Most residential patios and driveways are prepared, formed, poured and sealed within 2 to 4 consecutive business days, weather permitting
Foot traffic after 24 to 48 hours, depending on temperature and humidity
Keep pets and children off the slab for at least the first 24 hours
Passenger vehicles after 7 full days; heavy trucks, delivery vehicles and motorhomes after 28 days
Concrete cures by hydration rather than drying: about 70% of design strength at 7 days, full structural cure at 28 days

facts.heading: Caring for your concrete
items: Sweep off leaves, fertilizer pellets and soil debris regularly
Reseal stamped and decorative concrete every 2 to 3 years, depending on sun exposure and foot traffic, or every 2 years in direct south-facing sun
Rinse with a garden hose or a low-pressure washer under 2,000 PSI with a wide fan tip
Use pH-neutral cleaners, mild dish soap or a dedicated concrete detergent; avoid acid washes, muriatic acid and caustic strippers
Treat oil and grease stains promptly with a degreasing agent
Never use rock salt, calcium chloride or chemical deicers on concrete; use plain sand for traction

faqs.q: Why is pricing quote-based rather than a flat fixed rate?
faqs.a: Every project has unique field conditions. Soil stability, site grade changes, demolition of old slabs, accessibility for concrete mixer trucks, reinforcement specifications and the finish you choose all change the scope, so we give a thorough, no-obligation on-site estimate instead of a generic rate.

faqs.q: Is stamped concrete suitable for patios and pool decks?
faqs.a: Yes. Stamped concrete is widely installed on residential patios, outdoor kitchens and swimming pool copings. Around wet areas like pool decks we add a micronized non-slip grip additive to the clear sealer coat for safe traction.

faqs.q: How durable is stamped concrete, and does it fade in UV?
faqs.a: Poured with appropriate PSI ratings, reinforced subgrades and high-grade UV-resistant iron oxide pigments, stamped concrete does not wash out or peel. The clear protective topical sealer shields the pigment from ultraviolet degradation.

faqs.q: How long does it take before I can use a new driveway?
faqs.a: Standard passenger vehicles can park and drive on the slab after 7 full days of cure time. Heavy trucks, delivery vehicles and recreational motorhomes should stay off it for a full 28 days.

faqs.q: What should I do about minor hairline cracks?
faqs.a: Minor micro-fissures and hairline shrinkage cracks do not threaten structural integrity. They can be sealed with color-matched flexible polyurethane or elastomeric joint sealants during routine maintenance to keep moisture out of the subbase.

faqs.q: Who owns and operates Castanon Concrete Designs?
faqs.a: Castanon Concrete Designs is locally owned and supervised on site by Marco Castanon, Owner and CEO, so every slab is checked for quality, alignment and finish by the person responsible for it.

faqs.q: How can I request a free on-site estimate?
faqs.a: Call or email us directly and Marco Castanon comes out to the property in person. He takes laser measurements, inspects how the ground drains, reviews stamp samples with you and compiles an accurate written scope of work. There is no obligation.

faqs.q: What factors affect the cost of a concrete project?
faqs.a: Total square footage, demolition and excavation, subgrade preparation, how easily a mixer truck or wheelbarrow can reach the work, the reinforcement schedule of rebar or fiber mesh, the thickness the slab needs - a 4-inch patio against a 5 to 6-inch heavy driveway - and how much decorative color and stamping you choose.

faqs.q: What are the typical steps in a concrete project?
faqs.a: On-site consultation and estimate, detailed layout and permitting where it is required, site clearing and laser leveling, subbase compaction, framing with wood or steel forms, rebar placed on chairs, the pour and finish, control joint cutting, and proper curing. Stamped work adds color hardener and release agent, pattern stamping, relief joints, power washing and two protective seal coats.

faqs.q: How is stamped concrete sealed and maintained?
faqs.a: Stamped concrete gets a professional-grade breathable acrylic or polyurethane sealer, solvent or water based, once the work is finished. Wash it periodically with a garden hose and mild soap, and reseal every two to three years depending on sun exposure and foot traffic.

faqs.q: How long does concrete take to cure?
faqs.a: Concrete cures through hydration rather than drying. It reaches roughly 70% of its compressive design strength within 7 days and hits its full structural cure milestone at 28 days.

faqs.q: When can I walk on freshly poured concrete?
faqs.a: Foot traffic is fine after 24 to 48 hours, depending on temperature and humidity. Keep pets and children off the slab for at least the first 24 hours.

faqs.q: What is the typical timeline from estimate to completed project?
faqs.a: Once an estimate is accepted and scheduled, most residential patio and driveway projects are prepared, formed, poured and sealed within 2 to 4 consecutive business days, weather permitting.

faqs.q: What patterns and textures are available for stamped concrete?
faqs.a: An extensive selection of architectural patterns: ashlar slate, random flagstone, European fan cobble, Roman slate, running bond brick and rustic timber wood-plank textures, combined with integral and topical color accents.

faqs.q: Is Castanon Concrete Designs licensed and insured?
faqs.a: Yes. Castanon Concrete Designs is fully licensed and carries comprehensive general liability insurance to protect your property throughout all phases of the project.
